project.goal: Build the most complete practical facility and incident database, including dated operational changes and reopenings.
project.phase: Research, reviews and four-hour maintenance resumed
project.summary: Current figures are measured from the catalogue, approved export and research queue. Clear dated Reuters reporting is sufficient; missing cause, damage or operating status does not block a supported incident.

milestones.title: Source research and provenance
milestones.detail: Reuters reports and legitimate Reuters reprints are collected with dates and attribution. Targeted research is not a complete inventory of every Reuters article.

milestones.title: Independent Luna review
milestones.detail: All 85 frozen groups were reviewed; 13 retain explicit holds. A Luna reviewer checked source-to-facility/date/assertion matching and applies supported candidates through the exact-version SQLite gate. Sol remains stopped.

milestones.title: Facility interface and galleries
milestones.detail: The local facility page and findings overview rendered in Safari. Cards, map, incident history, favorites, settings and galleries are available; this is not a fresh full UI test.

milestones.title: Historical Telegram archive
milestones.detail: The supplied 2022–2025 archive was reconciled with the prior text import; dated source posts and selected media were preserved. Photos retain their separate media provenance.

milestones.title: Regional expansion
milestones.detail: Original geographic scope first; Ukraine, NATO countries and worldwide phases are not active.

milestones.title: Media inventory · current files
milestones.detail: 158 unique incident-image paths; 51 facility-image entries across 48 facility IDs; 0 missing referenced files. File inventory only; this does not verify image identity or timing.

milestones.title: Facility photo-scout research
milestones.detail: 220 of 220 effective facility IDs checked; 76 dated image leads, 80 undated gallery leads, 64 not found in bounded searches, 0 confirmed pre-incident photos. 1 source images visually screened; source attribution remains separate from independent identification. Separate public-source research; no record approval, app/media integration, or deployment.

milestones.title: Scout handoff queue
milestones.detail: 1367 ready handoff batches; 979 distinct candidate snapshots. Reviewer: Immediate user-authorized batch complete; awaiting next eligible batch.. These are research handoffs, not approved records or SQLite proposals. Saved mechanical audit (2026-10-20T13:50:11.855236+00:00): 141/141 passed; 17 contain historical enrichments requiring correction review. This is not source approval.

milestones.title: Reuters retrospective · Luna
milestones.detail: Saved state: running; 61 search-window entries, 207 story-ledger entries including leads and corrections. Category follow-up: 6/6 bounded rounds; next: category backlog/correction reconciliation after checkpoint. Older-incident evidence follow-up: 4 bounded rounds saved. Stop at None% account allowance remaining; shared account meter. Targeted searches, not an inventory or review of every Reuters article since February 2022. Coverage is incomplete; ledger entries are not a unique reviewed-article count. The prepared application is complete; source research resumed. Sol remains stopped.

milestones.title: Reuters follow-up research
milestones.detail: 86/86 indexed references have saved decisions; checkpoint: 2026-10-20T11:17:24Z. Index entries can repeat or remain unresolved; this is not an incident or approval count. Saved decisions preserve source-access and identity/date holds. The independent application reviewer uses Luna; Sol remains stopped.

checks.title: Measured dashboard
checks.detail: Catalogue, queue and approved-export figures are recomputed locally. Snapshot generation is not a source review or a new test run.

checks.title: Exact review gate
checks.detail: Imported candidates retain exact hashes, source assertions, reviewer provenance and append-only publication history. Database totals below are measured, not fixed milestone counts.

checks.title: Local Safari preview
checks.detail: Facility interface and the findings overview loaded from the local HTTP server. Public pages.dev delivery is separate.

decisions: One clear dated Reuters report suffices; no mandatory second source or additional truth investigation. Preserve attribution and unknown details.
Independent Luna reviewer and scout remain separate. Sol and Astra remain stopped.
Luna work has no user-set usage cap under the latest override; platform limits apply, with no paid credits or resets.
A hit does not alone establish shutdown. Russian government/operator reopening assertions remain separately labelled Russian claims.
Local imports and overview updates are authorized; no new Git publication or deployment.
next_steps: Use the current local website and findings overview.
Revisit held assertions only when new evidence resolves their recorded reason.
Continue resumed Reuters/source research, independent Luna reviews and four-hour checks from saved cursors.
blockers: Source coverage is incomplete; public indexes and some source listings have access limits.
Unknown exact facility identities and concrete date conflicts remain held separately.
The local schedule requires this Mac and Codex to be available.
